authority.scope: GTK2 scrollbar stepper preview and comparison to the retained SR10.4 held-state evidence

runtime.display: :60 private Xephyr already open for this project

method.press_release_cleanup: Each left-button press releases in finally; each GTK2 window and socket host is destroyed after its captures.
method.per_direction_cell: 15x15 px (225 RGB pixels); hover baseline, held capture, then released capture.
method.full_window_capture_retention: Full owned-window images were cropped to 15x15 cells and removed; no Xephyr root capture was taken.

historical_comparison.normal_all_four_directions: R233/R234 matched the four retained SR10.4 normal arrow cells at 1:1 with zero differing pixels.
historical_comparison.left_right_up_held: Interaction transition is verified; direct held-pixel comparison against SR10.4 is not available, so historical fidelity for these three held arrows is not claimed.

validation.git_diff_check: passed for the GTK2 direction mapper and probe files
validation.visual_roi_inspection: All 24 cells are 15x15; the four arrow orientations are visible; hover and released pixels are identical for each direction.
validation.historical_fidelity_claimed: Only the down-held state, by exact 15x15 equality to R236; normal directions reuse R233/R234.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: The GTK2 four-direction press/release matrix now passes in both preview origins, closing a directional interaction-state gap. This estimate is technical work coverage only, not a visual fidelity score; three held arrows still lack direct SR10.4 pixel pairs and I167 remains open.

next: Continue GTK2 only. Obtain historical SR10.4 held-state evidence for left, right, and up arrows if the VUE controls can be presented safely; do not change the normal arrows or infer those held pixels by rotating the down-arrow sample.
